card.name: Linking words before blood cell terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "with", "per", "via" or "%" right before a blood cell name or smear term like neutrophilia, neutrophils, RBCs or peripheral blood smear, in lab-finding text.

modes.label: Lab count then cell type
modes.description: "with" or "%" after a white cell count or leukocytosis, just before neutrophils.
modes.example: and leukocytosis<< with>> neutrophilia. If DIES occurs

modes.label: Smear and cell-count phrasing
modes.description: Words like "per", "via", "blood" or "peripheral" leading into smear or high power field wording.
modes.example: estimate platelet count via peripheral<< blood>> smear.

card.writes: It raises the odds that the next word is "cells" or "cell" and related staining terms.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a blood cell name, when the text expects "cells" or a cell type next.
